Class JcefCoreBridgeTransport

java.lang.Object
org.cef.callback.CefNativeAdapter
org.cef.handler.CefMessageRouterHandlerAdapter
dev.copperbench.bridge.JcefCoreBridgeTransport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, org.cef.callback.CefNative, org.cef.handler.CefMessageRouterHandler
public final class JcefCoreBridgeTransport extends org.cef.handler.CefMessageRouterHandlerAdapter implements Closeable
Narrowly-scoped JCEF message router transport that connects CEF browser JavaScript queries to JcefBridgeEndpoint, returning versioned JSON outcomes or failing promises, and dispatching asynchronous domain events safely to the browser.
